notes: A Copy diagnostics button, on the Options page. When something goes wrong on a computer nobody can look at, one click puts the details on the clipboard - version, browser, where it got to, and the last folder problem. Paste it to whoever is fixing it. Nothing is sent anywhere by itself, and the page shows you every word before you copy it.
Your Windows or Mac username is removed from any folder name, so the report can be forwarded without a second thought.
